The modelling incorporates 3 data sources:
1. National Drug Treatment Monitoring System (NDTMS) information on people in 
community drug treatment.
2. Criminal justice system (CJS) information (combined Police National Computer arrest 
records, Offender Assessment System records on probation and NDTMS information 
on people in drug treatment in prisons).
3. Drug-related mortality information from the Office for National Statistics' (ONS) 
mortality register.
